crossRefs.note: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.
For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.
Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,
and they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned Yahweh their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and…
and he went out to meet Asa, and said to him, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! Yahweh is with you, while you…
He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.
Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
“For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and cut out cisterns for…
“Your own wickedness will correct you, and your backsliding will rebuke you. Know therefore and see that it is an evil…
“To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these…
“I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He answered, “I have not troubled Israel; but you, and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken Yahweh’s commandments, and you have followed the Baals.
translations.bsb: “I have not troubled Israel,” Elijah replied, “but you and your father’s house have, for you have forsaken the commandments of the LORD and have followed the Baals.
translations.kjv: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.
translations.asv: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of Jehovah, and thou hast followed the Baalim.
